benchmarks.name: Legal Research Bench (agentic, all-pass)
benchmarks.description: Legal Research Bench (Vals AI, arXiv:2610.00609v1, CC BY 4.0): 413 original U.S. legal research questions written by practising attorneys across eight areas of law. Models run as tool-using agents (web search, case-law search, page parsing, retrieval). Score = all-pass: an answer counts only if it meets every attorney-written rubric criterion and every cited authority verifies. Graded by a GPT-5.4 judge validated against attorneys.
